instruction: Cinematic still, medium full shot on a sandy beach under a clear blue sky. In the center foreground, the boy in the blue and black wetsuit (R2) rides on the shoulders of the man in the black wetsuit (R1). The boy (R2) points toward the left with his right arm and smiles, while the man (R1) holds a white surfboard under his left arm and looks toward the left with an open mouth. The man holds the boy's legs to secure him. Bright, direct daylight casts soft shadows on the sand.
